packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Providers package
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: Marks the model-provider code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Model capability check
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: Reports whether a verified model supports a given capability.

packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Model list
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: Gives each provider's models from Lonora's fixed list, and the owner's own server's models from what it listed.

packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Request sizing
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: Works out how large a request one model can take, from its context window.

packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Provider credentials
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: Holds a provider's key and base address for making calls.

packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Default model
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: Chooses the model a fresh install answers with before the owner picks one: each provider's set default from the list, skipping a provider whose key it rejects.

packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Owner server's models
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: Asks the owner's own model server which models it has and saves them; no other provider is asked.

packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Key check
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: Checks whether a provider accepts a typed key, by the answer's status alone, without reading its models.

packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Model size table
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: The built-in table of context-window and output sizes per model family.

packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Provider registry
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: Builds the right connector for each provider, using the owner's base address when set.

packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Provider resilience
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: Sorts out provider failures, decides when to back off and retry, and tracks each provider's health.

packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Model router
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: Sends each request to the chosen model and falls through an ordered list of backups when one fails.

packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.name: Routing policy store
packages/providers/src/lonora_providers/.description: Reads and saves the rules for which model answers.
